title: CloudWatch and CI/CD
description: Add observability, alarming, and automated deployment to your AWS ASP.NET Core app.
longDescription: A production ASP.NET Core app on AWS needs telemetry, alarms, and automated releases. This module covers CloudWatch Logs and Metrics, AWS CodePipeline, and cost management for AWS resources.
whatYouLearn: Send custom metrics and logs from C# to CloudWatch
Create alarms and dashboards for ASP.NET Core apps
Build a CodePipeline for automated deployment
